tasks.title: Drop redundant singleton test_authoring oracle in normalize_plan when target module exists and a committed oracle already covers it
acceptance_criteria: A new top-level helper _drop_redundant_precommitted_oracles(tasks, repo_root) is added immediately BEFORE normalize_plan (R-ANCHOR), and is the only new top-level symbol.

normalize_plan signature is unchanged (def normalize_plan(plan, repo_root=None)); only one new call line is added to its body, immediately after tasks = _dedupe_oracles(tasks) and before _enforce_module_first(tasks).
With repo_root=None the new pass is a strict no-op (no filesystem access) and output is byte-identical to prior behavior.
Only harness/planner/plan_normalizer.py is modified; no other symbol or file is touched. _dedupe_oracles len(group) <= 1 guard is left intact.

Drop is conservative: a singleton test_authoring oracle is removed ONLY when its mutation_target module file exists under repo_root AND a committed covering oracle (other than the oracle's own files_touched) exists; otherwise KEEP. Dependents of a dropped oracle are rewired with no dangling references, no self-edges, deduplicated. KEEP on any TypeError/ValueError/OSError.

spec.objective: Add a single conservative, repo_root-aware pass to harness/planner/plan_normalizer.py that drops a SINGLETON test_authoring oracle whose mutation_target module already EXISTS on disk and is already covered by a committed oracle file, rewiring dependents. The pass is threaded into normalize_plan AFTER _dedupe_oracles, is a strict no-op when repo_root is None, and never removes anything except on a confident on-disk match.
functional_requirements: Add a NEW top-level helper _drop_redundant_precommitted_oracles(tasks, repo_root) placed immediately BEFORE normalize_plan (R-ANCHOR: a new top-level function rides as an extra node placed immediately before its anchor, anchored on normalize_plan).
The helper returns tasks unchanged when repo_root is None (strict no-op, NO filesystem access) so repo_root=None output is byte-identical to prior behavior.

The helper considers only SINGLETON test_authoring tasks: a non-empty mutation_target that appears on exactly one test_authoring task, so multi-oracle groups already handled by _dedupe_oracles (len(group) <= 1 guard) are untouched. Use the existing _is_test_authoring(task) and _mutation_target(task) helpers.
For each candidate, require the module file to EXIST: compute module_path via _module_path(target) and require Path(repo_root, module_path).is_file(); otherwise KEEP.

For each candidate, require a committed covering oracle: a file matching Path(repo_root).glob('tests/**/test_' + leaf + '.py') where leaf = target.rsplit('.', 1)[-1], OR any tests/**/*.py under repo_root that imports the dotted module ('from <target> import' / 'import <target>'); the matching file MUST NOT be one of this oracle's own files_touched; require a non-empty match, otherwise KEEP. Follow the same glob + leaf-stem convention as _sanitize_impl_verification_commands.

Drop the oracle(s) ONLY on a confident match (module exists AND committed covering oracle exists) and rewire dependents using the SAME drop_map dependency-rewire pattern as _dedupe_oracles: remove the dropped id from every other task's dependencies (do not point at a non-existent task), de-duplicated, never introducing a self-edge or a dangling reference. Operate idempotently and KEEP on any TypeError/ValueError/OSError.

Thread the new pass into normalize_plan immediately AFTER 'tasks = _dedupe_oracles(tasks)' and before _enforce_module_first(tasks), as 'tasks = _drop_redundant_precommitted_oracles(tasks, repo_root)', WITHOUT changing normalize_plan's signature (def normalize_plan(plan, repo_root=None)).
spec.interfaces: in-place EDIT of harness/planner/plan_normalizer.py. New top-level helper _drop_redundant_precommitted_oracles(tasks, repo_root) -> tasks, placed immediately BEFORE normalize_plan (R-ANCHOR extra node). normalize_plan(plan, repo_root=None) body gains exactly one new call line. Reuses existing module machinery: _module_path, _mutation_target, _is_test_authoring, the _dedupe_oracles drop_map rewire loop, and the Path(repo_root).glob('tests/**/test_<leaf>.py') convention from _sanitize_impl_verification_commands. partial_edit semantics: a single __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ list containing the new helper symbol(s) anchored BEFORE normalize_plan, plus a 'symbol' entry for normalize_plan reproduced BYTE-FOR-BYTE from the staged target with ONLY the one new call line added.
edge_cases: singleton sibling DROPPED when the target module exists AND a committed oracle file (tests/**/test_<stem>.py importing/sharing-stem) exists under repo_root.
sibling KEPT when no committed oracle exists for the target (conservative keep).
dependents of a dropped oracle are rewired (no dangling dependency references introduced).
conservative keep-on-doubt: repo_root=None, or module absent, or no matching committed oracle -> oracle KEPT, plan otherwise byte-identical.
non_goals: Integration testing of the end-to-end planner/daemon dispatch flow is OUT OF SCOPE (integration-test requirement excused — the pre-committed oracle file is the full contract).
Does NOT change _dedupe_oracles's existing plan-internal dedupe; the len(group) <= 1 guard stays. The singleton/on-disk drop is a SEPARATE conservative pass.
Does NOT change normalize_plan's SIGNATURE (normalize_plan(plan, repo_root=None)); only its body gains one new call line threading repo_root into the new pass.
Does NOT drop anything when repo_root is None (strict no-op, no filesystem access).
Must be CONSERVATIVE: drop ONLY on a confident match; when in doubt, KEEP. No aggressive removal.

Does NOT touch _enforce_module_first, _strip_unresolvable_dependencies, _sanitize_impl_verification_commands, _inject_oracle_sources, _force_smoke_gated_leaf_impl, _canonicalize_oracle_paths, _correct_meta_task_type_by_target, _inject_credential_naming_constraint, or any file other than plan_normalizer.py.
Does NOT author new tests — the pre-committed RED oracle is the authoritative contract.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Authoritative contract is the pre-committed oracle tests/planner/test_dedupe_precommitted_oracle.py, which builds an in-memory plan (IMPL_1 + singleton ORACLE_1 with mutation_target pkg.mod) and materializes a tmp_path repo_root containing pkg/mod.py and conditionally tests/pkg/test_mod.py (importing 'from pkg.mod import f'). No new test files are authored.

token_budget_ratio.note: Pre-committed oracle is the full contract; no new tests authored, so the implementation budget covers the minimal additive helper plus the byte-for-byte normalize_plan edit, with test_tokens kept >=1.5x for verifying the existing oracle goes green.
